scenarios.name: Release Settings does not offer an unaccepted search model
scenarios.given: the optional additional-language search model has not passed its required quality gate
scenarios.when: the user reads Settings from the initial viewport through the Recording explanation
scenarios.then: no additional-language model heading, download, enable, cancel or remove control is offered, while the Recording explanation remains reachable

scenarios.name: Shared Apple History rebuilds only stale derived optional vectors
scenarios.given: an owned archive has old optional-model vector files beside separately retained legacy preference and asset sentinels
scenarios.when: the application's shared default History model opens and rebuilds its index
scenarios.then: stale vectors are discarded, only installed Apple vectors or truthful missing vectors are retained, literal History finds the original record, and archive bytes, identities, timing, notes and sentinels remain unchanged
